expected: Zero-provider smoke should reconstruct the frozen prompt packet and replay the archived B10 first-action parser before any new model/provider execution.
observed: Packet reconstruction passed, but the smoke-local parser assumed an action/name field. Frozen B10 encodes actions as one-key mappings such as {click_element: {index: ...}}, so parser replay stopped at action_signature.
evidence_distinguishing_failure_layer: The exact archived B10 runner defines the action name as next(iter(action)) and parses click_element from the nested args.index field; the smoke-local parser used a different schema. No scientific treatment was executed.
single_variable_repair: Replace only the smoke-local parser with the exact frozen B10 action_signature semantics and regex fallback. Keep data, A0/A1/A2 prompts, model identity, endpoints, and authority unchanged. Rerun as smoke-v2 rather than overwriting smoke-v1.
what_would_falsify_repair: If the exact B10 parser semantics still fail to reproduce archived B10 action signatures, stop the smoke and investigate source/artifact drift rather than changing treatment design.
claim_status_before_after: unchanged; engineering repair efficacy remains untested
mainline_status: execution failure memory only; zero narrative scientific authority
lesson: When a smoke replays a frozen evaluator/parser, reuse its exact schema semantics rather than rewriting an intuitively equivalent parser. Parser-schema mismatch is execution failure, not evidence against the scientific repair hypothesis.
